Table 2. Homicide, by victim’s sex and victim-offender relationship, 1993–2010

a/Estimates based on characteristics of the first victim only. The FBI’s Supplementary Homicide Reports provide information on the victim-offender relationship with the first recorded victim in the data. For the small percentage of incidents with multiple victims (approximately 5% per year), the victim-offender relationship for victims beyond the first is recorded as unknown.
b/Intimate includes former or current spouses, boyfriends, and girlfriends.
c/Nonintimate includes nonintimate family members, friends, acquaintances, and strangers.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, based on data from FBI, Supplementary Homicide Reports, 1993–2010.
